cases.name: Sheridan Wahl
cases.about:
Wahl's former roommate said she was a person loved by many. The University of South Florida confirmed Sheridan Wahl was a marketing major at the university. She started there in Fall 2018. "She was the kind of person who would walk in a room and make friends with everyone there. It didn't matter if she knew them or not. You could start a conversation about anything with her," Echenique said. "She was just the sweetest person."

https://wpde.com/news/local/she-was-the-sweetest-person-sheridan-wahls-friend-remembers-joyful-times-together
cases.narrative: On 9/21/2021, her body was found behind the Hanna-Salem Fire Department on Highway 378 in Pamplico. Her burned car was found in a field about 10 miles away two days before her body was found.
